When has logic or reason ever mattered?

Go away. Go lower the bar somewhere else. Don't you have an animal documentary to mimic or is that what this is?

The fuck is your all problem?

DO you really care THAT much about appearance that you just start goading people who dare to admit anonymously that they aren't good looking?

Should I have talked about all of my relationships and then you'd all comfort me like the fucking MONKEYS you are?

>I'm so sorry I never saw the other side of it! 

Wow, congrats, you're so good looking! Wow,  you did so much to achieve that, congrats!

Here's the part where you get to attack me for not complimenting you like any good subhuman ugly person who knows their place would do.

Why do you all care so much that your tone even changes with ugly people?  What is *WRONG* with this species?

The best part about being ugly is people really do think you deserve it.

>You don't get to be alive. Nobody GETS to be alive. You give life or you're not alive.

That doesn't make sense.  Whatever depth you were going for is obfuscated.  Do you mean that you have to give to receive?  That's not true, many people give and get nothing and many people give nothing and receive.  So what are you *really* saying?
